args.title: Fix CSV parsing to handle trailing empty lines correctly
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Ensure the parsing logic correctly handles CSV files that end with an empty line by not treating it as a row, thus preventing 'Malformed row' errors.

The parsing logic does not correctly handle files ending with an empty line, leading to 'Malformed row' errors. The code will be adjusted to ensure such files are processed correctly.
